name: Mt. Ambulate - A night in the woods
source:
Mt. Ambulate is an non-serious adult gay furry visual novel with themes of mystery, romance and comedy. The game is still in development, and therefor everything is subject to change, the project was started basically at the start of the 2020 quarantine.

A group of six recently-graduated teens spend their final night together in the woods atop Mt. Ambulate. Everyone is splitting up for adult life after this night, so you'd better make the best of it... Romance, befriend and get to know a cast of five unique, date-able characters with their own personalities and stories to tell. Defuse conflict between the characters, or create it...

[From [url=https://doriam.itch.io/ambulate]Itch.io[/url]]
